profile_text.body:
Unisys is a public company traded under the ticker UIS, and it describes itself on its website as a global technology solutions company for cloud, AI, digital workplace, applications and enterprise computing. Its site presents AI advisory, solution development and scalable infrastructure alongside change management expertise, and it says its cloud offerings cover migration, modernization and cloud management across hosts including AWS, Azure and Google as well as customer data centers. It also describes agentic AI-driven service desk support, field services and device subscription options, and it points to an AI & Cloud Insights Report 2026 and peer-reviewed quantum computing research from its team.

The site quotes CEO Mike Thomson on AI governance, arguing that governance cannot wait for policy to catch up, and it notes that some content may be created or assisted by AI, with a disclaimer that Unisys does not guarantee all information is free from errors or omissions.

The company's profile lists its CIK as 0000746838 and its ticker as UIS. No products, lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
